# agyn_volume (Resource)

Manages an Agyn volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_volume" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  persistent      = true
  mount_path      = "/data"
  size            = "10Gi"
  description     = "Example persistent volume."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mount_path` (String) Mount path inside the container.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the volume.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Whether the volume is persistent.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `size` (String) Volume size (required when persistent is true).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the volume.
